summary: Cebu 5th District representative with 33 principal-authored bills. Authored higher barangay health worker pay, free dialysis for indigent patients and a national disaster risk finance insurance framework. Co-authored a plastic excise, a critical-illness expense deduction, income tax restructuring, disinformation penalties and party-list reform.
caveat: Direction of the co-authored income tax restructuring is unknown. Disinformation and party-list co-authorships are single issues and unscored.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored free dialysis for indigent patients (-3), barangay health worker pay (-2) and disaster risk insurance (-1); co-authored a critical-illness expense deduction (-1) and income tax restructuring (direction unreviewed).
